; limitPenColors.qmd - xochitl 3.28 (written against 3.28.0.172 sources)
;
; Choose which colors are offered for pens, highlighters and shaders. Hidden colors disappear
; from the stock pen menus (primary and secondary pen) and from colorDropdownOnMove.qmd.
;
; Settings: Settings, below "Toolbar position" -> "Available colors". Tap a swatch to show or hide it.
; The last visible color of a palette can't be hidden. Changes apply the next time a menu is opened.
;
; The list of hidden colors is stored with QtCore Settings, category "penColorFilter", key "hiddenColors".
; It is a comma-separated list of keys: "c<paletteEnum>" for palette colors, "a<argb hex>" for ARGB colors
; (highlighters and shaders). An empty list means all colors are shown. Hiding a color doesn't change
; strokes already drawn, and it doesn't change the pen's current color.

; Stock pen menu (WritingTool is used for both the primary and the secondary pen)
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/WritingTool.qml
    IMPORT QtCore 6.5 QtCore

    TRAVERSE PenTool
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            // The pen menus live as long as the toolbar, so re-read the setting each time the menu opens.
            QtCore.Settings {
                id: penColorFilter
                category: "penColorFilter"
            }
            property string hiddenColorsCache: penColorFilter.value("hiddenColors", "")
            onFoldoutVisibleChanged: {
                if (foldoutVisible) {
                    penColorFilter.sync();
                    hiddenColorsCache = penColorFilter.value("hiddenColors", "");
                }
            }
            function isColorHidden(toolColor, rgb) {
                const key = toolColor === Line.ArgbCode ? "a" + (rgb >>> 0).toString(16) : "c" + toolColor;
                return hiddenColorsCache.split(",").indexOf(key) !== -1;
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE FoldoutGrid:ColorGrid > Repeater > ArkControls.FoldoutGridItem
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                visible: !root.isColorHidden(toolColor, rgb)
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Settings UI, shown below the "Toolbar position" panel (this widget has the toolbarProvider,
; whose colorProfile PenColorModel needs).
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/toolbar/qml/ToolbarPositionChooserWidget.qml
    IMPORT QtCore 6.5 QtCore
    IMPORT com.remarkable 1.0

    TRAVERSE Item#root
        ; Other extensions (e.g. colorDropdownOnMove.qmd) add panels here too. They all use the same
        ; replacement, so the order in which the mods are applied doesn't matter.
        REPLACE implicitHeight WITH {
            implicitHeight: childrenRect.height
        }

        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            QtCore.Settings {
                id: penColorFilterSettings
                category: "penColorFilter"
                property string hiddenColors: ""
            }

            function penColorKey(toolColor, rgb) {
                return toolColor === Line.ArgbCode ? "a" + (rgb >>> 0).toString(16) : "c" + toolColor;
            }

            function isPenColorHidden(toolColor, rgb) {
                return penColorFilterSettings.hiddenColors.split(",").indexOf(root.penColorKey(toolColor, rgb)) !== -1;
            }

            // Toggle one color. A palette always keeps at least one visible color.
            function togglePenColor(repeater, toolColor, rgb) {
                const key = root.penColorKey(toolColor, rgb);
                let hidden = penColorFilterSettings.hiddenColors.split(",").filter(k => k !== "");
                const index = hidden.indexOf(key);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    hidden.splice(index, 1);
                } else {
                    let visibleCount = 0;
                    for (let i = 0; i < repeater.count; i++) {
                        if (repeater.itemAt(i)?.selected) {
                            visibleCount++;
                        }
                    }
                    if (visibleCount <= 1) {
                        return;
                    }
                    hidden.push(key);
                }
                penColorFilterSettings.hiddenColors = hidden.join(",");
                // Write through right away, so open documents see it the next time a menu opens.
                penColorFilterSettings.setValue("hiddenColors", penColorFilterSettings.hiddenColors);
                penColorFilterSettings.sync();
            }

            component PenColorFilterSection: ColumnLayout {
                id: section
                required property string title
                required property int tool
                spacing: 0
                Layout.fillWidth: true

                PenColorModel {
                    id: sectionModel
                    tool: section.tool
                    colorProfile: root.toolbarProvider.colorProfile
                }

                ArkControls.Caption {
                    text: section.title
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                Flow {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Repeater {
                        id: sectionRepeater
                        model: sectionModel
                        ArkControls.FoldoutGridItem {
                            id: filterItem
                            required property var displayColor
                            required property string displayName
                            required property int toolColor
                            required property var rgb
                            required property bool stacked
                            required property int borderWidth
                            focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                            label: qsTranslate("xofm::libs::toolbar::PenColorModel", displayName)
                            // "selected" (inverted) means the color is available.
                            selected: !root.isPenColorHidden(toolColor, rgb)
                            iconComponent: ArkControls.ColorSwatch {
                                size: 39
                                borderColor: filterItem.selected ? "white" : "black"
                                color: displayColor
                                duoColor: stacked ? Qt.darker(displayColor, 1.6) : ""
                                duoOpacity: 1
                                antialiasing: false
                                borderWidth: filterItem.borderWidth
                                rotation: stacked && borderWidth == 0 ? 90 : 0
                            }
                            onPressed: root.togglePenColor(sectionRepeater, toolColor, rgb)
                            implicitWidth: 112
                            implicitHeight: 112
                            Component.onCompleted: contentItem.spacing = 8
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            ArkControls.Panel {
                id: penColorFilterPanel
                // Stack below every panel that comes before this one.
                y: {
                    let offset = 0;
                    for (const child of root.children) {
                        if (child === penColorFilterPanel) {
                            break;
                        }
                        offset += child.visible ? child.height : 0;
                    }
                    return offset;
                }
                width: parent.width
                label: qsTr("Available colors")
                description: qsTr("Highlighted colors are shown in the pen menu and the color picker. Tap to show or hide a color.")
                showAttachment: true

                attachment: ColumnLayout {
                    spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.medium

                    PenColorFilterSection {
                        title: qsTr("Pens")
                        tool: Line.Ballpointv2
                    }
                    PenColorFilterSection {
                        title: qsTr("Highlighter")
                        tool: Line.Highlighterv2
                    }
                    PenColorFilterSection {
                        title: qsTr("Shader")
                        tool: Line.ShadingMarker
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
